name: adaptive-engineering
description: One assistant with active-session local memory, general learning and project-first engineering.

interface.longDescription: Continue with one assistant using bounded recall and selective capture while the skill is active. Keep memory in a user-owned local vault, configure its location per device, and sync manually with Git. Learn general subjects with source labels and preserve reviewed engineering knowledge. Coding stays project-first with focused validation. Requires Python and local filesystem access; safe memory publication requires Git and POSIX filesystem operations.
defaultPrompt: Set up my Adaptive Engineering knowledge vault.
Find the closest existing implementation for this task and make the smallest coherent change.
Learn this material and save a concise candidate note to my configured engineering vault.
